preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 8
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 8) representing the count of distinct integers.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(x) <= 10**12 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line contains n distinct space-separated integers ai (2 ≤ ai ≤ 10¹²).

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and (int(stdout) >= n) and (int(stdout) <= 2 * sum(1 for x in stdin.split()[1:] if int(x) > 1) - 1)
postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the minimum number of vertices in a divisor tree containing all ai. The tree must satisfy: (1) leaves are primes, (2) each internal node's value is the product of its children's values, and (3) all ai appear as node values. The output is bounded by the trivial upper bound of 2*sum(primes) - 1 (each prime as a leaf and one root).

postconditions.expression: all(int(ai) in tree_values for ai in stdin.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The divisor tree must include all input integers ai as node values (tree_values is the set of all node values in the constructed tree).

The tree must satisfy the divisor tree conditions: (1) leaves are primes, (2) internal nodes' values equal the product of their children's values, and (3) all ai are present in tree_values. The tree_structure is the adjacency representation of the tree, and tree_values is the set of node values.
